summary: The Platform Reliability Engineer focuses on ensuring the performance, scalability, and reliability of enterprise-wide data platforms and pipelines.
responsibilities: Design and maintain reliable, scalable, and fault-tolerant data platforms
Implement platform monitoring, alerting, and automated remediation
Optimize compute, storage, and workflow performance
Collaborate with DevOps, data engineering, and ML teams
Support disaster recovery, backup, and high-availability strategies

education: 5–10 years of experience in platform reliability or data infrastructure

skills_required.name: Strong knowledge of distributed data systems (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka)
Cloud and platform architecture expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure)
